title: Write Playwright E2E test: export flow
description: Write Playwright E2E test for the site export flow. Tests that a ZIP export can be triggered and downloaded for a ready prospect.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E test file exists at tests/e2e/export.spec.ts
Tests: export button is visible in editor, clicking Export as ZIP triggers a download, downloaded file is a valid ZIP containing index.html

steps.details: Navigate to /edit/[slug]. Find the ExportButton. Click 'Export as ZIP'. Listen for the download event with `page.waitForEvent('download')`. Assert download.suggestedFilename() ends with '.zip'.
Save the downloaded file to a temp path. Use `jszip` in Node.js to open the ZIP. Assert it contains 'index.html'. Assert index.html size > 1000 bytes.
Run `npm run test:e2e tests/e2e/export.spec.ts`. Tests pass.
